title: Fix validate_stmt false-positive: validate only key-list, not field names, as regex
description: validate_stmt() in sieve-native/src/lib.rs validated ALL Str forms when :regex tag present, including header field names like 'X[Special]'. A valid script like 'if header :regex "X[Special]" "test.*"' would be rejected because 'X[Special]' is not a valid regex. Fix: use rposition to find the LAST Str/StringList before Block (the key-list position) and only validate those as regex patterns. Added two regression tests: compile_regex_does_not_validate_header_name_as_pattern and compile_regex_validates_pattern_in_string_list.
